hooks.text: 角色自动攻击，玩家的生存职责集中在穿越怪群、精确站位与升级选择
hooks.excerpt: Your character attacks automatically; survival is up to you. Dodge through swarming enemies, position carefully, and make smart upgrade choices as the screen fills with chaos.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 技能、神器与被动可组合成精密施法者或清屏火力等截然不同的Build
hooks.excerpt: Combine skills, artifacts, and passives to create wildly different builds each run, from precise spellcasters to screen-clearing powerhouses.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 分支地图让每次选择重塑旅程，联机队伍还必须投票决定下一条路线
hooks.excerpt: Navigate a branching map where every choice reshapes your journey. Choose your path through escalating battles, quests, shops, shrines, treasure, and bosses. In co op, vote with your party to decide your fate and adapt your strategy as the Realm shifts around you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
